videos.title: Levan Vacated... Here's What Should Happen Next!
videos.summary:
The armwrestling world changed overnight when Levan Saginashvili  vacated the Super Heavyweight World Title with East vs West Armwrestling Promotion. 

That leaves a lot of unanswered questions.

Who fights for the vacant title?
Who earns the next opportunity?
What happens at 105 kg and 115 kg?
And where do I fit into all of this?

In this video, I lay out what I believe is the most logical path forward for the Super Heavyweight and 105 kg divisions, explain why I think those matchups make sense, and share where I stand if the league calls.

At the end of the day, I just want to compete.

Let me know what you think in the comments.
